objective: Produce a leadership decision brief comparing Academic, Research, Placement, Finance performance for academic year 2025-26 against NIRF, NAAC, strategic plan, identifying below-target areas with options and risks.

analysis_steps.title: Confirm read access and freeze the data cut
analysis_steps.detail: Re-read the data-scope register for Academic, Research, Placement, Finance and record the cut timestamp so every figure in the brief is reproducible.

analysis_steps.title: Pull the prior-year baseline for trend context
analysis_steps.detail: Retrieve the same KPI set for the preceding closed year so every KPI is reported with its year-on-year movement, clearly labelled as trend context rather than as the reporting-period figure.

analysis_steps.title: Aggregate academic metrics across departments
analysis_steps.detail: Academic Agent pulls pass percentage, CO/PO attainment, curriculum compliance per department for academic year 2025-26, keeps the per-department spread, and flags any department with stale or missing data.

analysis_steps.title: Aggregate research metrics across departments
analysis_steps.detail: Research Agent pulls publications, citations, grants sanctioned per department for academic year 2025-26, keeps the per-department spread, and flags any department with stale or missing data.

analysis_steps.title: Aggregate placement metrics across departments
analysis_steps.detail: Placement Agent pulls placement percentage, average package, internship completion per department for academic year 2025-26, keeps the per-department spread, and flags any department with stale or missing data.

analysis_steps.title: Synthesise institution-wide KPIs
analysis_steps.detail: KPI Agent applies only the approved KPI definitions to the domain aggregates, showing formula and source for each; enrolment-weighted, never a plain mean of department percentages.

analysis_steps.title: Compare each KPI to its approved target
analysis_steps.detail: Compute variance against NIRF, NAAC, strategic plan; classify each KPI as on-target / at-risk / below-target using the approved thresholds.

analysis_steps.title: Attach department-level drill-down evidence
analysis_steps.detail: For each KPI, record the traceable path KPI -> contributing department -> source metric -> source system, so leadership can trace any number back.

analysis_steps.title: Draft options and risks for every below-target KPI
analysis_steps.detail: For each KPI missing target, draft 2-3 options with cost, owner, timeline and the risks/trade-offs of each. Options only — no action is taken.

analysis_steps.title: Run validation, then route to the human gate
analysis_steps.detail: Validation is a hard gate; on failure only the failing KPI is regenerated. The Principal/Registrar then approves, edits or overrides before circulation.

target_comparison.method: variance = actual - target, reported in the KPI's own unit alongside % of target achieved; no rounding may hide a miss

drilldown_policy: mandatory for every KPI — each KPI must carry its full department-level trace, not only the KPIs that miss target
evidence_requirements: Every figure carries source system, extraction timestamp and department scope.
Every KPI carries its formula and the approved target it is measured against.
Provisional or unreconciled figures are labelled inline, never presented as final.
Every option carries its risks, trade-offs and named owner.
Every option names an accountable owner and the risk that owner is accepting.
brief_structure: 2. KPI scorecard vs targets, with variance
validation_checks: each option lists its risks and trade-offs
no action is taken without leadership approval
assumptions: Analysis is limited to academic year 2025-26; prior years appear only as trend context.
Only Registrar-authorised, institution-level read access is used; no department is queried directly.
KPI definitions and target values are the approved set — this plan does not redefine them.
SCOPE_CAVEAT: 3 provisional offers are excluded until the Placement Cell verifies them. -> Record the caveat in the brief's assumptions section.
